description: List the user's charts that stay updated (id, name, fixed link) and their destinations (id, type, name for Slack, Teams, Discord, email, webhook). Use it to find the ids that update_living_chart, send_chart_on_update and schedule_chart need. Needs a connection signed in to a free account (connector URL ending in /mcp/account).
name: list_my_charts
title: List my charts and destinations
